name: GAN i4 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core) - Minions Edition, Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The GAN i4 Minions Edition is GAN's flagship smart cube wrapped in an officially licensed Minions design, from the big-eyed Minion center cap to the custom banana-yellow interior. Under the theme sits a serious 3x3: an omni-directional smart ball core with contact-free Hall-effect sensing, a double-MagLev magnetic system, and a real-time gyroscope that reconstructs every move in the companion app.
features: 10-minute quick charge: The cube tops up fast on the included Minions GanPod, so it's ready when you are.
72 handfeels: A wide range of tuning combinations lets you dial the cube to the feel you want.
Themed bundle worth keeping: Ships with the Minions GanPod, Minions-themed packaging, a themed cube bag, DIY Minions stickers, tuning tools, and the manual.
72 tuning combinations: Adjust the cube across a broad range of setups to match your turning style, using the included tuning tools.
Double-MagLev system: 76 magnets drive both attraction and repulsion for fast, controlled turning, with 35-degree self-aligning to help layers snap into place.
Omni-directional smart ball core: Corner pieces anchor to a central ball for auto-alignment and stability through fast, aggressive turning.
